name: qfd_sp_res_ser-c1-a8053d6da
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 contract v4b slot cell qfd_sp_res_ser (3 instances sp_res_ser_0..2, 777.6 x 518.4): hardened cluster under the die master name. 8 hard slot tiles (qfd_res_slot_ru) + the serialiser head in the ninth cell; parent = one flop at every die pin, two more stages for the row-0 tiles, reset relay, wires. Clock: balanced spine with each tile's routed insertion as its leaf target; every seam registered on both sides. Floorplan, hops and cuts: physical/res_ser/qfd_sp_res_ser_fp.json (tools/qwen_vm_me/res_ser_cluster_fp.py).

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: c1: no flat serialiser. A hardened CLUSTER drawn top-down: 8 closed result-slot tiles (qfd_res_slot_ru, 216 x 142.56, CLOSED TT +150.27 / FF +14.44) on a 3 x 3 grid with routing channels, the ninth cell = serialiser head; the parent holds only pin flops and A / M / X staging registers (~9.0k flops, every hop <= 360 um, row 0 in two hops), a balanced clock spine whose leaf targets include the tiles' own insertion (338.7 ps); i word of each slot enters straight above its tile. Earlier routes were one flat block (setup -757..-1,142 ps post-CTS, pin density 20.8 b/um).
